settings.title: Details
settings.content:
One size, 25 × 22 × 14 cm (approx. 10" W × 8.5" H × 5.5" D). A real wallet, your cards, a lip color and your keys, with room for a slim pouch alongside them.

Inside: fully lined with a zipped interior pocket. Structured walls mean it holds its shape and stands up on its own.

Carry: short rolled leather top handles, made for the hand or the crook of the elbow.

Base: rounded leather corner patches and small metal feet, so the canvas never sits on the ground.

settings.title: Delivery
settings.content:
Free shipping on all orders over $75. Once your order is placed, it ships and arrives within 7 to 10 business days.

Because each bag is made in limited production runs, sold-out colors may take 4 to 8 weeks to restock.

We accept returns within 30 days of delivery for items in original, unused condition with all tags attached. Exchanges are always free.

settings.title: Care
settings.content:
Body: Tightly woven heavyweight canvas.
Flap, Handles & Trim: Full-grain leather with burnished edges and visible stitching.
Hardware: Gold-tone turn-lock, clasp plates, side buckles and base feet.
Interior: Fully lined with a zipped pocket.

Care: Spot-clean the canvas with a soft, damp cloth. Wipe the leather with a clean, dry cloth and condition it every few months. It will darken and gain character with wear. Store stuffed and away from direct sunlight.

settings.heading: Customize Your Delphine
settings.intro: Add an organizer, charm, or scarf to complete your bag, all designed to match.

settings.headline: Structured Enough To Stand On Its Own
settings.body: The structured body holds its shape full or nearly empty. The short rolled handles sit easily in the hand, and the turn-lock and belted straps close it properly.

settings.heading: Two-Year Warranty
settings.body: Every Velantra bag is built to last. If anything fails in normal use, we’ll repair or replace it.

settings.headline: Full-Grain Leather and Heavyweight Canvas
settings.body: A full-grain leather flap, handles and trim over tightly woven heavyweight canvas. Structured on the shelf, and it softens and deepens in color with the years instead of wearing out.

settings.headline: Hardware That Does a Job
settings.body: A gold turn-lock that actually turns, two belted straps that cinch to a buckle on each side, and reinforced leather corners at every point that takes a knock. No logo anywhere, inside or out.

settings.headline: Made in Limited Runs
settings.body: Produced in small quantities. When a color sells out, it can be weeks before it returns.

settings.headline: Lined, with a zipped pocket
settings.body: A full lining and a zipped interior pocket for the things you would rather not have loose in the bag.

settings.headline: Rolled leather top handles
settings.body: Full-grain leather, rolled and hand-finished, sized for the hand and the crook of the elbow.

settings.headline: A turn-lock that actually turns
settings.body: A working gold turn-lock and two belted straps that cinch to a buckle on each side. It closes properly over a full bag, every time.

settings.headline: Corner patches and metal feet
settings.body: Rounded leather corners at every point of contact and small metal feet underneath, so the canvas never touches the ground. Set it down anywhere.

settings.headline: The Bag You Don't Have To Swap
settings.body:
Most days end with a bag change. What you carried since morning is too much for dinner, and what you swap into is small enough that half of it gets left behind on the bed.

The Delphine is built to skip that step. Structured walls and a full-grain leather flap give it the presence to walk into a restaurant, and ten inches across takes a real wallet, your cards, a lip color and your keys, with the turn-lock closing properly over all of it. Set it on the table beside you and it stands up on its own, so nothing slides to the bottom and disappears.

Light Chocolate, Dark Chocolate and Army Green. No logo anywhere, inside or out.

settings.headline: Two years covered. Lifetime in our shop.
settings.body: Two-year warranty on materials and stitching. After that, we repair anything for the cost of materials. Send it back. Get it back better than you sent it.
